title: schc_parity_vectors.h source-dir copy shadows CMake build-dir generation; pick one source of truth
description: Found by robustness+security codereview passes of project-LICHEN-worker6-wrxl (P2). lichen/tests/schc_parity/main.c:9 includes "schc_parity_vectors.h" with quotes, so clang resolves it to the SOURCE-DIR copy (includer-dir precedes -I), while lichen/tests/schc_parity/CMakeLists.txt:10-24 also generates a build-dir copy at configure time. The two were byte-identical when wrxl landed, but any future JSON edit regenerates the UNUSED build copy while tests compile the stale source copy - silent stale-vector testing; the source copy is also untracked, polluting git status. Fix: pick one source of truth - either (a) delete the source-dir copy and let CMake generation be authoritative (matches pre-wrxl behavior), or (b) commit the source copy as the artifact and drop the CMake generation step. Option (a) preferred (no generated artifacts in git); then verify schc_parity still builds+passes on a fresh checkout.
close_reason: schc_parity now has a single source of truth for its vectors: the committed source header schc_parity_vectors.h is the only include (main.c quoted include resolved to it anyway - includer-dir precedes -I), and the CMake build-dir generation (find_package(Python3), execute_process, build-dir include path) is removed. Chose the commit-the-artifact option over deletion (no file deletions; fresh checkouts previously depended on configure-time generation). Regen path documented in BOTH the CMakeLists comment and the header banner (from the repository root), and - the key fix from review - gen_vectors.py's banner now emits the identical 6-line comment so generator output is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed artifact (verified: regen diff empty; first regen would otherwise have silently clobbered the instructions). Fresh-checkout simulation green: no generated header in build tree, compiles from source copy, ctest 1/1 (clang+ASan/UBSan, 57/57 vectors). 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness, reviewer-model passes): no P0-P2 on the delta; all three converged on the residual staleness blind spot (JSON edit without regen leaves all three parity legs green) - filed as es5w (--check mode + parity-script step 0), a follow-up task, not part of this fix. CMakeLists hygiene verified (no leftover vars; sibling suites unaffected; test_common.cmake sanitizer posture identical).
